note: A/B is same-day, same-host, CPUs 0-7, 3x180 s each, same manifest with only balancer.native.o differing (other two objects byte-identical). Within-run ratios are not comparable across runs because the eBPF baseline moved from 154.89 ns/run (C4) to ~122 with other lanes' guests on the host.

ab_result.verdict: wash: 0.41% faster than the same-source control, at or below the run-to-run noise floor (the two runs' eBPF baselines agree to 0.45%). Sinking 49 -> 7 map_lookup_elem calls and shrinking the object 10021 -> 9464 B did not change runtime. Not a regression; not an improvement to claim.
